column3: “We shall all be dead” renders “all of us are dying.”
NASB uses the past perfect “had done … had requested” where the Hebrew has simple narrative past forms.
NASB uses “had given” for a simple past; “they let them have their request” renders “they let them ask.”
Close to the Hebrew; “children” renders “little ones.”
“to the very day” renders “on the bone (substance) of this day.”
“a night to be observed” renders “a night of watchings.”
“on that same day” renders “on the bone (substance) of this day.”
